negative_controls: every single deleted-edge restoration breaks its simultaneous decoder
p=2 has redundant empty star and dimension three
odd p=3 loses one edge against the naive balanced complete cut
omitting the bipartite branch gives a false fifth weight at p=4
scope: Finite independent graph-code checks only. Partition DP exhausts all labeled vertex partitions and all cuts within blocks for p=3,4,5,6. Literal edge-subset ranks are exhaustive at p=2,3; literal code subspaces are exhaustive at p=3,4, and rank-three subspaces at p=5. Full graph-code weight distributions are checked at p=5,...,9. Uniform formulas require the separate mathematical proof; no supplier or kappa claim.
